Equipment:

Raw Water 
 Clarifier

Solid

Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection 
I1, which must be performed every three months as indicated by M3 in the title block.

Each clarifier is 
equipped with surface skimmers to remove floating oil and scum. The function of 
the raw water clarifier is to clarify nile river water for use in plant

Technical Specification for

2)

El-Khimah PS 4x315MW.

This document certified by eng. 
Afaf Ebrahim Eldib CEPC inspection and quality control head sector MPIS 
Coordinator and reviewed by eng. Nageh Soliman Shoosha .
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, ... etc
